patterns.message: lib/adaptiveSchema and components/adaptive must never depend on the dedicated Claim Verification / Video Verification implementations — those are protected, out-of-scope features (query-routing redesign). Use the handoff intents (claim_verification / media_authenticity_review) and routeClassifiedQuery instead. Note: lib/verificationGate/* and cross-feature shared utilities in lib/verification/ (generateMemo.ts, shareText.ts, consensusScoring.ts) are fine — they're shared infrastructure the adaptive UI already legitimately reuses, not claim-verification-internal.
